extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create a new article (e.g., someone trying to create 'Quidditch at Penn State')
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia article with a given title: explains account/autoconfirmation requirements, searching for existing pages or redirects, using the article wizard or draft submission, handling recent-creation/database delays, and checking deletion logs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a prerequisite for creating pages; without an autoconfirmed account you cannot create a new article. Alternatives (see below) exist for users who are not autoconfirmed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create a full article directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed or new to editing), use the article wizard to draft the page for review by experienced editors or file a new-article request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / check alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Quidditch at Penn State" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, verify whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examining backlinks can reveal existing coverage or redirects and help determine whether a separate article is needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation / database delay check
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a page exists but cannot see it, allow time for propagation or use the purge feature to refresh page caches before creating a duplicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm correct capitalization and create redirects if appropriate instead of making a separate article for only a capitalization difference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page may have been deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a prior article was removed, consult the deletion log and deletion rationale to understand issues (notability, sourcing, policy violations) before attempting to recreate the page.
